routes.title: Tamsin Trail
routes.editorialNotes: OSM labels this relation as a bicycle route. The Royal Parks identifies the Tamsin Trail for walking and cycling; pedestrian access, current diversions and the exact geometry still require human review. No turn instructions or accessibility suitability are asserted. Review rejected the original as a complete loop because the endpoints are distinct. Two continuous one-way sections were derived without adding a connector. Night access restrictions and unlit, variable surfaces apply.
routes.reviewMethod: AI desk review; not field checked

routes.title: Tamsin Trail · 1

accessReview.limitations: AI desk review only. No field inspection or accessibility certification. All 42 source ways designate pedestrian use; no private/no-access or construction tag was found. The park authority promotes the trail for walking. Current park notices impose autumn night closures; use these sections in daylight and follow current official notices. Unlit shared paths, variable surfaces, bridges and hills; no reviewed turn instructions, guaranteed conditions or complete return circuit. Each section ends within the park; plan the return independently. The original approximately four-metre loop gap is not joined or traversed by either section.

routes.editorialNotes: Continuous one-way source geometry, not a loop. Original OSM database is retained with ODbL source availability. Direction, difficulty, live conditions and wheelchair suitability are not asserted.
